definitions: A widespread trend in which large numbers of workers voluntarily resigned from their jobs.
A period of high employee turnover, particularly in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
examples: The Great Resignation led to significant labor shortages in several industries.
Many factors contributed to the Great Resignation, including burnout and a desire for better work-life balance.
Companies are still grappling with the long-term effects of the Great Resignation.
